snippet.title: Cosmo Tales - First Official Trailer - Embark on an Interstellar Adventure!
snippet.description:
Experience the first full glimpse into the world of Cosmo Tales!
Meet new heroes, unravel cosmic mysteries, and discover exotic planets in our first official trailer after the teaser. The universe is calling – are you ready to answer?

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601630/Cosmo_Tales/

 Stay tuned for more updates and join the Cosmo Tales community:
 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cosmotalesgame/
 Discord: https://discord.gg/3gMd7NfQcg
 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cosmotalesgame
